name: farm-phone-ai-office
description: FARM PHONE AI OFFICE — Autonomous Multi-Device Control Platform

scripts.stop: powershell -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001,3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { if ($processId = $_.OwningProcess) { if ($processId -gt 0) { Stop-Process -Id $processId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } }"
scripts.setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test:single-device:automated: npm run test:e2e:mock --workspace @farm-phone/api && npm test --workspace @farm-phone/device-agent && node --test tests/live-one-device.contract.mjs
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/database && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd packages/database && npx prisma db seed
scripts.docker:up: echo Firebase / Standalone Mode Active (Docker not required)
